summary:
CO3-1 is fixed and has a guard. CO3-2's repair is not right, so the lane is not ready to ship as it stands.

**CO3-1 (no check that an awake octopus coming down lands on its own spot).** I reproduced the old problem and then showed it gone:
- Before the repair: the mutant K1 drops `restPhase() !== 'up'` in on.octUp (js/app.js:542), so every octopus coming down is put on the blanket. On the pre-repair app and smoke, it passed the whole of scenario Z, 54/0. Nothing caught it.
- After the repair: the same mutant on the repaired tree fails Z part 5 with 16/1. Only the new Z-5a check fails ({"an":"blanket","d":1.6649}).
- Unmutated, the repaired tree passed the new check 3 times: Z full 55/0, then Z part 5 alone 17/0 twice. The repair agent had 4 passes of its own.

**CO3-2 (`|| octWithMe()` in sleepNow said to be unreachable).** The repair removed the condition, saying it could never be reached. It can. The rest window ends in the attic and the octopus starts walking to the blanket (lieDown). If the nap limit or the day passes during that walk of up to 6 s, restPhase() becomes 'up', so octResting is false. If the player climbs the stairs then, the octopus follows. The walk is ended on arrival upstairs, and the walk's `.then` calls sleepNow(t) without `place`. So the octopus falls asleep upstairs.
- Repaired tree: asleep upstairs for 88 of 89 frames, saved state 'sleep' (two runs). The screenshot shows it asleep on the upstairs rug with the '자는 중' label.
- Pre-repair tree (with the condition): it is moved to the blanket asleep, as the first-round fix intended.
- Base a0483dd: asleep upstairs, same as the repaired tree.

This breaks item 3 of the fix brief ("never a sleeping octopus upstairs, in any path you find"). The case is rare: a midnight or 20-minute-limit crossing inside a walk of at most 6 s while the player climbs.

**Old behaviour on an untouched a0483dd, and the fixed tree.** On a0483dd the octopus vanishes from the upstairs room when the turn ends (8 frames upstairs without it). On the repaired tree it stays upstairs in all 57 frames. Tapping it shows the turn's line, and the mirror opens its sheet. Going down puts it on the blanket, climbing again does not bring it, and it naps on the blanket. No sound or AudioContext either way.

**Suites on a copy of the repaired tree.**
- npm test: every sub-suite 0 failed.
- Font check: stale: none.
- A: 74/0.
- Z: full 55/0; part 5 alone 17/0 twice.
- Load was 7 to 16 throughout. Nothing old failed, so no control run was needed.

The repair adds no player-facing text. The only smoke diff against the pre-repair tree is the Z-5a block, and it weakens no existing check. The tree was not touched, and my /dev/shm copies are deleted.

problems.title: Removing `|| octWithMe()` from sleepNow reopens a path where the octopus falls asleep upstairs
problems.where: js/app.js:1401 (sleepNow) together with js/app.js:1397 (lieDown's walkTo('blanket').then -> sleepNow(t) without place); scene js/scene3d.js:3344 octMountLoft / octResting
problems.what: lieDown checks napOver() once, then walks the octopus to the blanket while rest stays set. If napOver() becomes true during that walk (the day changes, or NAP_MS 20 min since the turn ended passes), restPhase() returns 'up', so on.octResting is false and octMountLoft lets the octopus follow a player who climbs. octEndWalk resolves the walk, and the `.then` calls sleepNow(t) with place false. With the repair's `if (place)`, nothing moves it down, so the octopus sleeps upstairs (state 'sleep', saved 'sleep'). The repair report and the new comment say this call can never happen upstairs ('위층에선 watching() 이 거짓이라 늘 place'), but the call was decided in the attic and runs after the climb. The pre-repair condition `place || octWithMe()` covered this case. Fix brief item 3 asks for no sleeping octopus upstairs on any path. The case is rare: the crossing must fall inside a walk of at most 6 s, while the player climbs.
problems.evidence: Probe: Z part '9', inserted into a copy of tools/smoke.js. Source: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/recheck-owner3/probe/part9.js. Run with SMOKE_ONLY=Z SMOKE_Z=9 P9_ANCHORS=door P9_AW=8000. Steps: a stay-home turn; the octopus is put on 'door' with wandering off; the player is walked to the attic stairs; the date hook is moved on the first frame that lieDown walks to the blanket; then the player climbs. Repaired tree, two runs (probe/p9-final-2.log, p9-final.log) and the shot run (p9-shot-final.log): up=true, st 'sleep', saved 'sleep', sleepUp 88 of 89 upstairs frames, first upstairs frame {st:'walk', phase:'up'}. Pre-repair app (probe/p9-prerepair.log, p9-shot-prerepair.log): 1 upstairs frame, then down, asleep on the blanket, sleepUp 0. Base a0483dd app (probe/p9-base.log): the same as the repaired tree (88 frames). Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/recheck-owner3/probe/p9-final-360.png (octopus asleep on the upstairs rug, '자는 중' label).
problems.suggested_fix: Restore `if (place || octWithMe())`, which is the pre-repair behaviour. Alternatively, in lieDown's `.then`, re-check octWithMe() (pass place) or napOver() (wake instead of sleeping, as lieDown's own napOver branch does). Then add the probe above to Z part 5 as a check: first upstairs frame, octopus never asleep upstairs. It must fail when the guard is removed. Also correct the sleepNow comment, which claims the call always has place set upstairs.

per_fix:
CO3-1:
- Before the repair: reproduced. Mutant K1 (`if (an !== 'blanket') octPlace('blanket')`) on the pre-repair app and smoke passed the whole of scenario Z, 54/0 (logs/K1-prerepair-Zfull.log).
- After the repair: gone. The new Z-5a check '틈이 끝나 따라 온 문어는 내려오면 제 자리 (창가 — 담요로 옮기지 않는다)' (tools/smoke.js:5575) passes on the repaired tree: Z full 55/0, then Z part 5 alone 17/0 twice (logs/final-Zfull.log, final-Z5-a.log, final-Z5-b.log).
- Fails on revert: yes. K1 on the repaired tree gives Z part 5 16/1, and only that check fails, with {"an":"blanket","st":"idle","phase":"up","d":1.6649} (logs/K1-final-Z5.log).

CO3-2:
- Before the repair: the condition existed and had no failing check.
- After the repair: the condition is removed, but the 'unreachable' premise is false. My probe P9 shows the octopus asleep upstairs on the repaired tree and on base a0483dd, and moved to the blanket on the pre-repair tree.
- Guarding check: none. No check in the suite covers this path (see RC3-1).

OW-3 itself (the original finding, on an untouched copy of a0483dd at /dev/shm/co3/base; app.js, scene3d.js, index.html and salon.js compared equal to a0483dd):
- Old behaviour: the octopus vanishes upstairs when the turn ends (goneInLoft 8 frames, up false; probe/base-S.log).
- Repaired tree: it stays upstairs in all 57 frames, the tap line works, the mirror sheet opens with 0 asks, rest.left stays frozen upstairs, going down puts it on the blanket, climbing again does not bring it, and it naps on the blanket (probe/final-S.log).
- Guards: the first round's 5-3a, 5-3b and 5-3c, all of which pass on the final tree.
mutations:
- K1 on the pre-repair tree (`restPhase() !== 'up'` dropped from on.octUp, app.js:542): Z full 54/0. The mutant survives, which reproduces CO3-1.
- K1 on the repaired tree: Z part 5 16/1. Only the new Z-5a check fails (an 'blanket', d 1.6649).
- Pre-repair versus repaired sleepNow, compared with probe P9 rather than a smoke check: the pre-repair version moves the octopus down asleep, the repaired version leaves it asleep upstairs. No check in the suite fails on either version, which is RC3-1.
- I did not rerun the first round's mutants MA to MW, because their code did not change in this repair.

held: CO3-1 is fixed. The new Z-5a check is deterministic: it reads the first attic frame through the __zEach hook, with wandering off and the page clock paused. It passed 3 of 3 times here, and 4 times in the repair agent's runs.

The repair's smoke diff against the pre-repair tree is only the Z-5a block. The earlier z6 assertion (the octopus follows again after the window ends) is unchanged in strength; it now starts from 'window' instead of wherever the octopus stood.

The OW-3 owner default holds on the repaired tree at 360x740 with touch: the octopus stays visible upstairs after a stay-home turn ends there, tapping it shows the turn's line ('열일곱에서 잠이 들었어', data-tap 1), and the mirror opens its sheet with 0 asks. Its rest window does not count down upstairs (OW-4), going down puts it on the blanket, climbing again does not bring it, and it naps on the blanket. No audio request and no AudioContext.
No new or changed player-facing text in the repair. Only a code comment and a test label changed. The font check says stale: none.

The repair touched only sleepNow (js/app.js:1401) and the Z-5a block in tools/smoke.js, all inside the lane. git status in /home/user/ppolppol-fix-owner shows only the four intended files, and I did not modify the tree.
